question: Whenever I cast a Spirit or Arcane spell, Hikari, Twilight Guardian may exile itself. Am I forced to exile Hikari every time?

expected.shortAnswer: No: you may choose not to exile Hikari.
expected.answer: You may choose not to exile Hikari.
